problem.title: Word Ladder
problem.problemStatement: Given two words, beginWord and endWord, and a dictionary of valid words, find the length of the shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord. A transformation consists of changing exactly one character, and every intermediate word must exist in the dictionary. Return 0 if no transformation exists.
problem.input: String beginWord String endWord Integer n List of n words
problem.output: A single integer representing the length of the shortest transformation sequence.
